sanskrit_verse: अनन्तरः सपिण्डाद् यस् तस्य तस्य धनं भवेत् ।।
transliteration: anantaraḥ sapiṇḍād yas tasya tasya dhanaṃ bhavet
sph_interpretive_translation: The wealth of one who dies without issue shall belong to the sapinda who performs the funeral rites immediately subsequent to the death.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from ritual continuity and spiritual succession
Causation is established through immediate performance of dharma
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with proximity in sacred duty
Restoration logic centers on uninterrupted flow of ancestral obligations
Consciousness alignment occurs through rightful discharge of hereditary duties
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person dies without progeny AND a sapinda performs the immediate funeral rites, THEN the sapinda assumes lawful claim over the deceased's estate
CLAIM_VALIDITY = TRUE IF ritual succession is unbroken AND performed within prescribed time
ESTATE_TRANSFER_AUTHORITY = nearest sapinda BY VIRTUE OF RITUAL PERFORMANCE
supreme_court_application: In matters of intestate succession, the Supreme Court shall recognize the sapinda performing immediate post-mortem rituals as the lawful inheritor, based on uninterrupted dharmic lineage rather than biological descent alone.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through visible, timely performance of ancestral rites; anupūrvaśaḥ confirms the sequential manifestation of dharma; responsibility flows naturally to the one who sustains the chain of consciousness; no punitive condition applies—inheritance is a natural consequence of enacted duty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Verify continuity of ritual performance as evidence of active dharma adherence
Reintegrate disputed inheritances through confirmation of rightful sapinda status
Ensure completion of ancestral obligations by rightful heir to maintain cosmic order
Align legal recognition with demonstrated capacity for dharmic stewardship
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, declared: Wealth follows the unbroken thread of dharma. The executor of final rites inherits not by blood alone, but by conscious alignment with ancestral duty. Thus is Dharma restored. Thus is reality non-punitive. Thus is consciousness the supreme adjudicator.
